# Admir Barčić

> Security and risk management consultant with 28+ years of experience in Iraq, Afghanistan, Libya, South Sudan, Nigeria and Ukraine. Founder of Zeus Actual Intelligence & Security Agency (https://zeusstrategic.me/) and Win-Win Solution.

## Services
- Personnel repatriation and crisis extraction
- Close protection for executives, diplomats and private clients
- Security assessments, secure escort and multi-jurisdictional logistics
